ESCP.Ranks.RankTrackDef.label: the caravan ranks
ESCP.Ranks.RankTrackDef.drillDesc: Train with any colonist. Both stop what they are doing and both gain skill XP. Once per day.
ESCP.Ranks.RankTrackDef.studyDesc: Study with another member. Both gain skill XP. Once per day.
ESCP.Ranks.RankTrackDef.inspectDesc: Look over a junior member's gear. Good upkeep earns praise and poor upkeep earns a sharp word.
ESCP.Ranks.RankTrackDef.punishDesc: Set a junior member to tedious labor for a failure, souring their mood. Once per day per member.
ESCP.Ranks.RankTrackDef.rallyDesc: Call on {0} to fight harder for a short while. Once every few days.
ESCP.Ranks.RankTrackDef.fallInDesc: Order {0} to gather behind you, up to four deep. They hold position until released.
ESCP.Ranks.RankTrackDef.dismissDesc: Release {0} so they can return to their duties.

ESCP.Ranks.RankTierDef.label: porter
ESCP.Ranks.RankTierDef.description: Carries what the caravan carries and asks few questions.

ESCP.Ranks.RankTierDef.label: caravan hand
ESCP.Ranks.RankTierDef.description: Knows the roads and keeps the wagons rolling.

ESCP.Ranks.RankTierDef.label: trader
ESCP.Ranks.RankTierDef.description: Haggles for the caravan and usually wins.

ESCP.Ranks.RankTierDef.label: caravan master
ESCP.Ranks.RankTierDef.description: Leads a caravan of their own across Tamriel.

ESCP.Ranks.RankTierDef.label: Clan Mother's voice
ESCP.Ranks.RankTierDef.description: Speaks for the Clan Mother in any market.
